source.official_zh_TW: An official Traditional Chinese translation exists (Hsin-Ya Liao, Washington State University; Changya Hu, National Chengchi University). Contact the authors for formal use.
source.this_translation: Unofficial Traditional Chinese rendering for junior-high readers; verify against the official version before formal school administration.
source.riasec_mapping: Scale-to-RIASEC letters are a theoretical assignment based on Holland's classification of these interest domains, not a table reproduced from the source paper. Scale rankings do not depend on this mapping.
source.norms: None. Basic interest scales are interpreted ipsatively — by the rank order of a person's own 31 scale means.
